Their shared lakes generation step and empty spawn overrides do not establish material composition, absence of mobs/loot, actual geometry or encounter frequency. Piece-content interpretation and remaining effective attributes are still required.

All 66 roots share the Lithostitched jigsaw assembly contract, empty spawn overrides and civilian template content. grouping_decision.name: Moog's End Structures Mega Ship
grouping_decision.rationale: One modular Mega Ship family with material, attachment and wreck variants. Every variant has corresponding initial hull, middle and end modules, sharing 48 by 48 by 48 initial/middle bounds and 35 by 20 by 23 end bounds. Side and upper attachments differ. Three wreck variants use zero start height and beard_thin terrain adaptation; five airborne variants use positive start offsets and no terrain adaptation. These are related ship configurations, not eight unrelated authored families. Exact definitions preserve differing spawn overrides, terrain checks and heights; template ownership preserves entity and loot differences. Equal module bounds alone do not prove identical occupied geometry or gameplay.

biome_and_modifier_constraints.rarity_scope: All 22 inline variants specify chance=3 after their terrain filter. This is not an observed bridge frequency or an independent one-in-three chance per chunk; the selector can try multiple candidates.
biome_and_modifier_constraints.rng_initializer: Consumes two nextLong values, forces their low bits to one, combines them with candidate X/Z and constants to reseed the supplied random source, then returns the same position. No additional position or eligibility test.
biome_and_modifier_constraints.scope: Biome resolution uses existing merged packaged tags and the verified biome registry. Dimension overlap uses the captured live possible-biome lists, not observed successful bridge placement. Standalone configuration registration and external modifications remain unresolved.

direct_encounter_content.authored_or_natural: No authored template entities or direct processor-spawned enemies identified. Any natural enemies require biome/runtime attribution, which is still unresolved.
direct_encounter_content.generated_spawners: No direct spawner block reference or spawner configuration in the captured processors; no spawner block entity in the packaged templates. External generation modifications remain outside this finding.
direct_encounter_content.intended_hostility: Environmental bridge infrastructure; no authored encounter is present in the verified template entities or direct processor calls. This is a source-based interpretation, not observed safety.
direct_encounter_content.loot_table_source: No direct container-loot assignment in the captured processors; packaged bridge templates have empty block-entity lists. This is not a statement about ordinary block drops or external loot injection.
direct_encounter_content.mob_source: No direct entity-spawning call in the fourteen captured processor/module/interface classes; all fourteen packaged templates have empty entity lists. Natural biome spawning and external retained-mod effects are not excluded.
direct_encounter_content.scope: Direct template/processor contribution only. The captured processors perform block replacement, support extension and state adaptation. Delegated engine/API behavior and whole-stack modifications are not proven absent by this source scan.

placement_eligibility.banks: Endpoint centers are length + 1 blocks apart. Both must canOcclude and have WORLD_SURFACE height <= sea level. At each endpoint, count the center plus contiguous qualifying lateral cells on each side, stopping that side at its first failure or width/2. Each endpoint count must reach numSolidBlocksNeeded.
placement_eligibility.sampling_plane: Sea level minus one. The generator subsequently anchors the template at sea level.
placement_eligibility.scope: These are the custom terrain checks. Biome filtering, selector variants and rarity modifiers remain separate packaged constraints; no world observation is inferred.
placement_eligibility.search: For each lateral offset from width/2 + widthOffset + 1 (inclusive) to 16 - width/2 - widthOffset (exclusive), try longitudinal offsets 0 through 15. Integer division is used. Swap X/Z roles for non-Z-axis variants. Return only the first valid candidate, or an empty stream.
placement_eligibility.source: BridgePlacement.getPositions in the captured generator manifest.
placement_eligibility.span: Every cell from lateral -width/2 through width/2 and longitudinal minWaterZ through maxWaterZ (inclusive) must satisfy BlockState.liquid at sea level minus one. The predicate does not specifically test water.
placement_eligibility.surface_classification: Surface liquid-crossing placement intent, supported by the bank heightmap and sea-level checks. This is not proof of player visibility or observed generation frequency.

generation.processing_stage: StructureTemplate.placeInWorld runs before the custom processor list is applied in order.
generation.rotation: isZAxis=false uses COUNTERCLOCKWISE_90; true retains default rotation.
generation.scope: Captured generation control flow, not observed placement success, discovery frequency or final support geometry. Full processor effects and placement eligibility still require reconciliation.
generation.selection: Randomly choose from remaining inline placed features; return on first successful place result, otherwise remove that candidate and continue until exhausted.
generation.success_limit: AbstractTemplateFeature discards the placeInWorld boolean. BridgeFeature returns true for a non-null loaded template; this does not prove all blocks were placed.

support_geometry.behavior: Replace the marker with the first supplied block state, then descend at fixed X/Z through air or liquid while Y > 0, using the second supplied state. Stop at Y <= 0 or a block that is neither air nor liquid.
support_geometry.limit: The descent uses literal Y=0, not the dimension minimum build height. setBlock return values are discarded; this is source-derived placement intent, not an observed completed pillar.
support_geometry.source: DynamicLegProcessor calls ITemplateFeatureProcessor.generatePillarDown for template support markers.
support_geometry.vertical_size: Template Y sizes describe the bridge body only. Supports may extend below that envelope; total occupied height depends on terrain and placement success.

generation.vertical_anchor: WorldGenLevel.getSeaLevel() replaces the incoming origin Y before template placement.

yungsbridges:bridges.mechanism: NeoForge add_features biome modifier to placed bridge_list, then configured multiple_attempt_single_random with inline placed bridge variants.
yungsbridges:bridges.relationship: Stone/wood, intact/broken and axis variants contribute bridge layouts. Template and rotation entries are not separate canonical families; final family attribution and effective generation remain open.

template_content.scope: All fourteen packaged templates have empty entities and block_entities. Eleven are referenced by the verified bridge selector. Dimensions are unrotated template envelopes, not observed assembled/occupied geometry. Generator transformations and marker-block handling remain unresolved; unreferenced templates are not assumed active.

non_registry_content.scope: Verified contribution paths only; remaining providers, family attributes, configuration and generated-world observations still require reconciliation. Not an accepted canonical family count.

scope: Working family inventory. Group relationships, provider coverage and attributes remain unresolved. Not a canonical total or exit-gate pass.
